heading: Credit for alcohol fuel, biodiesel, and alternative fuel mixtures

tree.heading: Allowance of credits
tree.text: There shall be allowed as a credit— No credit shall be allowed in the case of the credits described in subsections (d) and (e) unless the taxpayer is registered under section 4101.

children.text: against the tax imposed by section 4081 an amount equal to the sum of the credits described in subsections (b), (c), (e), and (k), and
against the tax imposed by section 4041 an amount equal to the sum of the credits described in subsection (d).

children.heading: In general
children.text: For purposes of this section, the alcohol fuel mixture credit is the product of the applicable amount and the number of gallons of alcohol used by the taxpayer in producing any alcohol fuel mixture for sale or use in a trade or business of the taxpayer.

children.heading: Applicable amount
children.text: For purposes of this subsection—

children.heading: In general
children.text: Except as provided in subparagraphs (B) and (C), the applicable amount is—
in the case of calendar years beginning before 2009, 51 cents, and
in the case of calendar years beginning after 2008, 45 cents.

children.heading: Mixtures not containing ethanol
children.text: In the case of an alcohol fuel mixture in which none of the alcohol consists of ethanol, the applicable amount is 60 cents.

children.heading: Reduction delayed until annual production or importation of 7,500,000,000 gallons
children.text: In the case of any calendar year beginning after 2008, if the Secretary makes a determination described in section 40(h)(3)(B) with respect to all preceding calendar years beginning after 2007, subparagraph (A)(ii) shall be applied by substituting “51 cents” for “45 cents”.

children.heading: Alcohol fuel mixture
children.text: For purposes of this subsection, the term “alcohol fuel mixture” means a mixture of alcohol and a taxable fuel which— For purposes of subparagraph (A), a mixture produced by any person at a refinery prior to a taxable event which includes ethyl tertiary butyl ether or other ethers produced from alcohol shall be treated as sold at the time of its removal from the refinery (and only at such time) to another person for use as a fuel.
is sold by the taxpayer producing such mixture to any person for use as a fuel, or
is used as a fuel by the taxpayer producing such mixture.

children.heading: Other definitions
children.text: For purposes of this subsection—

children.heading: Alcohol
children.text: The term “alcohol” includes methanol and ethanol but does not include— Such term also includes an alcohol gallon equivalent of ethyl tertiary butyl ether or other ethers produced from such alcohol.
alcohol produced from petroleum, natural gas, or coal (including peat), or
alcohol with a proof of less than 190 (determined without regard to any added denaturants).

children.heading: Taxable fuel
children.text: The term “taxable fuel” has the meaning given such term by section 4083(a)(1).

children.heading: Volume of alcohol
children.text: For purposes of determining under subsection (a) the number of gallons of alcohol with respect to which a credit is allowable under subsection (a), the volume of alcohol shall include the volume of any denaturant (including gasoline) which is added under any formulas approved by the Secretary to the extent that such denaturants do not exceed 2 percent of the volume of such alcohol (including denaturants).

children.heading: Termination
children.text: This subsection shall not apply to any sale, use, or removal for any period after December 31, 2011.

children.heading: In general
children.text: For purposes of this section, the biodiesel mixture credit is the product of the applicable amount and the number of gallons of biodiesel used by the taxpayer in producing any biodiesel mixture for sale or use in a trade or business of the taxpayer.

children.heading: Applicable amount
children.text: For purposes of this subsection, the applicable amount is $1.00.

children.heading: Biodiesel mixture
children.text: For purposes of this section, the term “biodiesel mixture” means a mixture of biodiesel and diesel fuel (as defined in section 4083(a)(3)), determined without regard to any use of kerosene, which—
is sold by the taxpayer producing such mixture to any person for use as a fuel, or
is used as a fuel by the taxpayer producing such mixture.

children.heading: Certification for biodiesel
children.text: No credit shall be allowed under this subsection unless the taxpayer obtains a certification (in such form and manner as prescribed by the Secretary) from the producer of the biodiesel which identifies the product produced and the percentage of biodiesel and agri-biodiesel in the product.

children.heading: Other definitions
children.text: Any term used in this subsection which is also used in section 40A shall have the meaning given such term by section 40A.

children.heading: Termination
children.text: This subsection shall not apply to any sale, use, or removal for any period after December 31, 2024.

children.heading: In general
children.text: For purposes of this section, the alternative fuel credit is the product of 50 cents and the number of gallons of an alternative fuel or gasoline gallon equivalents of a nonliquid alternative fuel sold by the taxpayer for use as a fuel in a motor vehicle or motorboat, sold by the taxpayer for use as a fuel in aviation, or so used by the taxpayer.

children.heading: Alternative fuel
children.text: For purposes of this section, the term “alternative fuel” means— Such term does not include ethanol, methanol, biodiesel, or any fuel (including lignin, wood residues, or spent pulping liquors) derived from the production of paper or pulp.
liquefied petroleum gas,
P Series Fuels (as defined by the Secretary of Energy under section 13211(2) of title 42, United States Code),
compressed or liquefied natural gas,
any liquid fuel which meets the requirements of paragraph (4) and which is derived from coal (including peat) through the Fischer-Tropsch process,
compressed or liquefied gas derived from biomass (as defined in section 45K(c)(3)), and
liquid fuel derived from biomass (as defined in section 45K(c)(3)).

children.heading: Gasoline gallon equivalent
children.text: For purposes of this subsection, the term “gasoline gallon equivalent” means, with respect to any nonliquid alternative fuel, the amount of such fuel having a Btu content of 124,800 (higher heating value).

children.heading: In general
children.text: The requirements of this paragraph are met if the fuel is certified, under such procedures as required by the Secretary, as having been derived from coal produced at a gasification facility which separates and sequesters not less than the applicable percentage of such facility’s total carbon dioxide emissions.

children.heading: Applicable percentage
children.text: For purposes of subparagraph (A), the applicable percentage is—
50 percent in the case of fuel produced after September 30, 2009, and on or before December 30, 2009, and
75 percent in the case of fuel produced after December 30, 2009.

children.heading: Termination
children.text: This subsection shall not apply to any sale or use for any period after December 31, 2024.

children.heading: In general
children.text: For purposes of this section, the alternative fuel mixture credit is the product of 50 cents and the number of gallons of alternative fuel used by the taxpayer in producing any alternative fuel mixture for sale or use in a trade or business of the taxpayer.

children.heading: Alternative fuel mixture
children.text: For purposes of this section, the term “alternative fuel mixture” means a mixture of alternative fuel (other than a fuel described in subparagraph (A), (C), or (E) of subsection (d)(2)) and taxable fuel (as defined in subparagraph (A), (B), or (C) of section 4083(a)(1)) which—
is sold by the taxpayer producing such mixture to any person for use as fuel, or
is used as a fuel by the taxpayer producing such mixture.

children.heading: Termination
children.text: This subsection shall not apply to any sale or use for any period after December 31, 2024.

tree.heading: Mixture not used as a fuel, etc.

children.heading: Imposition of tax
children.text: If—
any credit was determined under this section with respect to alcohol or biodiesel used in the production of any alcohol fuel mixture or biodiesel mixture, respectively, and
any person— then there is hereby imposed on such person a tax equal to the product of the applicable amount and the number of gallons of such alcohol or biodiesel.
separates the alcohol or biodiesel from the mixture, or
without separation, uses the mixture other than as a fuel,

children.heading: Applicable laws
children.text: All provisions of law, including penalties, shall, insofar as applicable and not inconsistent with this section, apply in respect of any tax imposed under paragraph (1) as if such tax were imposed by section 4081 and not by this section.

tree.heading: Coordination with exemption from excise tax
tree.text: Rules similar to the rules under section 40(c) shall apply for purposes of this section.

tree.heading: Denial of double benefit
tree.text: No credit shall be determined under subsection (d) or (e) with respect to any fuel with respect to which credit may be determined under subsection (b) or (c) or under section 40, 40A, or 40B.

tree.heading: Limitation to fuels with connection to the United States
tree.text: For purposes of this subsection, the term “United States” includes any possession of the United States.

children.heading: Alcohol
children.text: No credit shall be determined under this section with respect to any alcohol which is produced outside the United States for use as a fuel outside the United States.

children.heading: Biodiesel and alternative fuels
children.text: No credit shall be determined under this section with respect to any biodiesel or alternative fuel which is produced outside the United States for use as a fuel outside the United States.

tree.heading: Energy equivalency determinations for liquefied petroleum gas and liquefied natural gas
tree.text: For purposes of determining any credit under this section, any reference to the number of gallons of an alternative fuel or the gasoline gallon equivalent of such a fuel shall be treated as a reference to—

children.text: in the case of liquefied petroleum gas, the energy equivalent of a gallon of gasoline, as defined in section 4041(a)(2)(C), and
in the case of liquefied natural gas, the energy equivalent of a gallon of diesel, as defined in section 4041(a)(2)(D).

children.heading: In general
children.text: For purposes of this section, the sustainable aviation fuel credit for the taxable year is, with respect to any sale or use of a qualified mixture, an amount equal to the product of—
the number of gallons of sustainable aviation fuel in such mixture, multiplied by
the sum of—
$1.25, plus
the applicable supplementary amount with respect to such sustainable aviation fuel.

children.heading: Definitions
children.text: Any term used in this subsection which is also used in section 40B shall have the meaning given such term by section 40B.

children.heading: Registration requirement
children.text: For purposes of this subsection, rules similar to the rules of section 40B(f) shall apply.

children.heading: Coordination of credits
children.text: With respect to any gallon of sustainable aviation fuel in a qualified mixture, this subsection shall not apply to any such gallon for which a credit under section 45Z is allowable (as determined without regard to subsection (a)(1)(A) of such section).

children.heading: Termination
children.text: This subsection shall not apply to any sale or use for any period after September 30, 2025.
